notes.title: Patch notes for EA v0.1.65
notes.content:
- Improvements of the maps and ai
- Various bug fixes

notes.title: Patch notes for EA v0.1.30
notes.content:
- Fixed character-despawn causing a crash
- Fixed character stuck in idle state sometimes instead of becoming ragdoll
- Fixed some of the checkpoint respawn issues
- Some improvements of the maps
- Improved main menu
- Added missing animations of one of the characters

notes.title: Patch notes for EA v0.0.45
notes.content:
- Added new weapon pipebomb, removed frag grenade
- Improved some of the enemy animations and ai-behavior
- Fixed some of the audio issues

notes.title: Patch notes for EA v0.0.40
notes.content:
- Improved enemy AI
- Improved HUD and implemented game instructions

notes.title: Patch notes for EA v0.0.26b
notes.content:
Small balance update

- Added health-items dropped by the enemies on death. This is based on random chance, the amount of health is also random.

notes.title: Patch notes for EA v0.0.25
notes.content:
- Added new weapon molotov
- Updated default key bindings
- Added/Improved death animations, improved ragdoll physics
- Fixed audio spatialization bug
- Fixed grenade rendering bug
- Improved explosion debris
- Updated grenade throw animations

notes.title: Patch notes for EA v0.0.20
notes.content:
- improved first person animations and weapon effects
- fixed weapon switching, reloading bugs
- improved maps
- some minor HUD changes
- re-balanced difficulty
- grenade doesn't explode on entities anymore
- new models for some of the enemies
- improved some of the sound effects
- improved gore/gibs
- damage value for gore changed
- increased screen-shake value
- when low health, the screen now remains red until you heal

notes.title: Patch notes for EA v0.0.10b
notes.content:
This is an optimization patch

- Implemented occlusion culling
- updated grass, water, shadow quality

notes.title: Patch notes for EA v0.0.09a
notes.content:
- updated some of the sound effects
- improvements of player and enemy movement
- fixed hitboxes of one of the characters
- implemented dynamic lighting (muzzleflash and explosion)
